scope: Read-only source, dependency, source-hash and packaging inspection only. No local syntax checks, tests, builds, browser, preview server, scene/GPU execution or input automation.
sourceAudit: No malicious behavior, external runtime requests, storage, credentials, tracking, dynamic evaluation, workers or parent navigation found in scoped authored-source inspection.
dependencyAudit: Three.js 0.170.0 minified module, pinned by supplied package-lock. Scoped renderer/loader source inspection found ordinary optional loaders; the authored scene creates local procedural resources and does not call external loaders. License matches previously admitted text.
preview: Not captured; no screenshot was supplied in the imported payload. The host shows a text placeholder, not generated scene imagery.
producerEvidence: README claims 16 scripted walking waypoints reached, pool/crawl collision boundaries, and shader compilation without final console errors. These are producer claims; the Lab did not run the scene.
performanceEvidence: README reports GPU-synchronized 1280×720 render cost below measurement noise (~0–3 ms against ~8 ms synchronization overhead). Hidden-pane rAF was not measured. This is not an independently verified frame-time comparison or grade.
